title: AI can now draw pixel art and build models stroke-by-stroke!
author: uskyeeeee

comments.author: DoomVegan
comments.body: Error on voxel.  "OpenRouter API Key is missing. Please configure it in Settings."

replies.author: DoomVegan
replies.body: yeah this is kind of lame to require this middle piece.  Thumbs down.  Why wouldn't I just put in my ChatGPT key...

replies.author: uskyeeeee
replies.body: Just a quick heads-up: This website is strictly my experimental side project, which is why I unfortunately cannot provide free tokens. Also, it might be unrealistic to expect production-ready, usable game assets from it at this stage. However, if there are any specific export formats you need, please let me know!

replies.author: DoomVegan
replies.body:
FBX is basic for 3D.  Also it would be interesting how low poly you actually go.  I'd import the exports into unity or blender to make sure the orientations are correct. There was  another AI model creator but the faces were pretty absurd like 194k vs what should  be 152.  

[https://www.meshy.ai](https://www.meshy.ai)

https://preview.redd.it/og9gqosttf4g1.png?width=1008&format=png&auto=webp&s=d6bf29cd31eec6e2f931e2e270322b1c964d9e6f

if you tie directly to OpenAPI key I'll try it again.  Kind of curious which AI LLM is producing the best results in your opinion.

For a hobby project, seems cool. I think there is a golden opportunity to make something that actually works for game development. I think if you solve this bloat problem, you will have something commercially viable.  Even if you stick to something simple at first like terrain or buildings.    

Anyway, if you want a tester let me know. 

In Blender 152.

replies.author: FailedGradAdmissions
replies.body:
As a SWE, good job on the side project. And yeah tokens are expensive and it’s unrealistic to offer them for free for just a side project.

Startups and AI companies do, but they operate at a loss burning VC money in exchange for market capture. You can’t afford and should not try to be doing that.

In regards to the OpenRouter API key, that’s fine, it’s the norm for devs. And for those of you who are complaining about it. An OpenRouter key would be needed if OP is using a model that’s not from OpenAI. That simple.

You can’t use Sonnet 4.5 or MiniMax M2 and so on with an OpenAI API key.
